title: Create Crypto Day-of-Week Momentum Strategy using WFA Pattern
objective: Create a day-of-week momentum strategy for crypto (BTC, ETH, SOL) following the WFA pattern. Adapt Gold Rush Pro concept (day-of-week filtering + mean-reversion) but use MACD instead of RSI to avoid the RSI overfitting issue identified in lessons.
hypothesis: Day-of-week effects exist in crypto markets. Using MACD (a momentum oscillator) instead of RSI will provide similar mean-reversion signals but with different characteristics, potentially showing better out-of-sample performance than RSI-based strategies.
implementation_steps: Create strategy file: walk forward engine/src/strategies/crypto_day_of_week.py implementing generate_vectorized_signals() with MACD-based day-of-week entries
Create strategy params: walk forward engine/config/strategy_crypto_dow.json with parameters: macd_fast, macd_slow, macd_signal, atr_period, atr_sl_multiplier, hold_hours, entry_day
Create WFA config: walk forward engine/strategies/crypto_day_of_week/wfa_config.yaml configured for BTCUSD testing
Create strategy directory structure: walk forward engine/strategies/crypto_day_of_week/results/
Human runs WFA: cd 'walk forward engine' && .venv\Scripts\python scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py --config strategies/crypto_day_of_week/wfa_config.yaml

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA completes without errors and produces valid results

fallback_if_blocked: If crypto data format is incompatible, adapt strategy to use XAUUSD or EURUSD from walk forward engine/data/
If WFA engine has issues, create standalone test using wfa_minimal.py pattern
notes: This adapts the Gold Rush Pro concept (day-of-week filtering) to crypto with MACD instead of RSI
The lessons learned indicate RSI-based strategies may be overfitted (best Sharpe 0.945)
MACD provides similar momentum signals but with different smoothing characteristics
Testing on multiple crypto assets (BTC, ETH, SOL) ensures generalizability
